summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a program to research environmental risk factors of neurodegenerative diseases, including creating Collaborative Centers for Neurodegenerative Disease Environmental Research and coordinating efforts across the Department of Health and Human Services.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a program within the Public Health Service Act to research environmental risk factors for neurodegenerative diseases, including setting up collaborative research centers. This directly expands public health research and infrastructure, aligning with a more public healthcare approach.
